name: quickbooks-mcp
description: Every QuickBooks Online Accounting entity, plus an offline SQLite mirror, cross-entity search, and AR/AP aging no SDK or read-only MCP ships.

quickbooks_access_token.title: QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN
quickbooks_access_token.description: Static access token, as an alternative to the refresh trio for a quick test. Intuit access tokens live one hour and nothing refreshes one supplied this way, so prefer the refresh credentials for anything long-running.

quickbooks_base_url.title: QUICKBOOKS_BASE_URL
quickbooks_base_url.description: Derived from QUICKBOOKS_REALM_ID automatically; set only for sandbox (QUICKBOOKS_ENVIRONMENT=sandbox does that too) or a nonstandard host.

quickbooks_client_id.title: QUICKBOOKS_CLIENT_ID
quickbooks_client_id.description: OAuth2 client ID from your Intuit developer app (Keys & Credentials, production keys). With the client secret and a refresh token, the connector mints and refreshes its own access tokens, persisting rotations so a restart survives Intuit's refresh-token rotation.

quickbooks_client_secret.title: QUICKBOOKS_CLIENT_SECRET
quickbooks_client_secret.description: OAuth2 client secret paired with QUICKBOOKS_CLIENT_ID.

quickbooks_environment.title: QUICKBOOKS_ENVIRONMENT
quickbooks_environment.description: QuickBooks Online environment (e.g. sandbox or production)

quickbooks_realm_id.title: QUICKBOOKS_REALM_ID
quickbooks_realm_id.description: Your QuickBooks Online company ID. Shown beside the refresh token in the OAuth Playground, and in any QBO URL as companyid=<realm>.

quickbooks_refresh_token.title: QUICKBOOKS_REFRESH_TOKEN
quickbooks_refresh_token.description: OAuth2 refresh token seed. Easiest source is Intuit's OAuth 2.0 Playground: authorize your app against your company with the com.intuit.quickbooks.accounting scope and copy the refresh token it prints. Intuit rotates this value; the connector persists rotations automatically.

quickbooks_token_url.title: QUICKBOOKS_TOKEN_URL
quickbooks_token_url.description: Intuit's production token endpoint by default; override only for testing.
